paite: Huan Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn ua; huchi in TOUPA'N Philistiate khut ah amaute kum sawmli sung apia hi.
heading: Samson Pianna
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight; and Yahweh delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

paite: Zorah ah Dan nam mi khat a-om a, amin Manoah ahi a, azi bel achiing a, nau anei kei hi.
english: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.

paite: Numei kiang ah TOUPA angel ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na chiing a, nau nei thei lou himah lechin na gai dia, tapa na nei ding hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to the woman, and said to her, “See now, you are barren and childless; but you shall conceive and bear a son.

paite: Huchi in pilvang in, uain leh zu hat leh siang lou thil himhim ne het ke'n.
english: Now therefore please beware and drink no wine nor strong drink, and don’t eat any unclean thing;

paite: 'Ngai in, na gai dia, tapa nei ding na hi ngal a. Alu ah mulmet tem himhim zat ahi kei ding; naupang bel sul a a-om lai a pan Pathian a dia Nazarit hi ding ahi ngal a.' Ama'n Israelte Philistia mite khut a pan hutkhiak apan ding," achi hi.
english: for, behold, you shall conceive and give birth to a son. No razor shall come on his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.”

paite: Numei in apasal kiang ah, "Pathian mipa khat ka kiang ah ahong a, amel Pathian angel mel bang ahi a, kihtakhuaitak ahi. Koilam mi ahia chih bel ka dong chitchiat kei a, ama'n lah amin ahon hilh sam kei hi.
english: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel of God, very awesome. I didn’t ask him where he was from, neither did he tell me his name;

paite: Himahleh ka kiang ah, Ngai in, na gai dia, tapa na nei ding. Huchi in uain leh zu hat himhim dawn ke'nla, siang lou thil himhim leng ne het ke'n. Naupang sul a a-om lai a pan asih tan in Pathian a dia Nazarit mi hi ding ahi, achi,” chi in agen hi.
english: but he said to me, ‘Behold, you shall conceive and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink. Don’t eat any unclean thing, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb to the day of his death.’”

paite: Huchi in Manoah in TOUPA kiang ah nget chihtak in angen a, akiang ah, "Aw TOUPA hehpih in huai Pathian mipa na hon sawl ka kiang uah hong nawn henla, naupang hong piang ding bang ka chih ding ua hong sinsak hen," achi hi.
english: Then Manoah entreated Yahweh, and said, “Oh, Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come again to us, and teach us what we should do to the child who shall be born.”

paite: Pathian in Manoah thugen ana ngaikhia hi. Loubuk a numei atut lai in akiang ah Pathian angel ahong nawn hi. Apasal Manoah bel akiang ah a-om kei hi.
english: God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field; but Manoah, her husband, wasn’t with her.

paite: Numei kintak in atai pah a, apasal ava hilh a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, zanlam a ka kiang a hong hohpa ka kiang ah ahong kilak nawn," achi hi.
english: The woman hurried and ran, and told her husband, saying to him, “Behold, the man who came to me that day has appeared to me.”

paite: Huchi in Manoah athou a, azi azui a, huai mi kiang ava tung uhi. Akiang ah, "Numei kiang a thu gen nang na hi maw?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi e,” achi hi.
english: Manoah arose and followed his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” He said, “I am.”

paite: Manoah in, “Na thu bang zel in hong tung hen. Naupang omdan ding bangchibang ahi dia, asep ding bang ahi dia le?" achi hi.
english: Manoah said, “Now let your words happen. What shall the child’s way of life and mission be?”

paite: TOUPA angel in Manoah kiang ah, "Numei kiang a ka gen tengteng ah amah pilvang hen.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.

paite: Grepgui a pan mawngmawng ane ding ahi kei a, uain leh zu hat adawn ding ahi kei. Siang lou thil mawngmawng leng ane ding ahi kei. Ka thupiak tengteng zui hen," achi hi.
english: She may not eat of anything that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing. Let her observe all that I commanded her.”

paite: Manoah in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Ka hong thum uh. Hehpih in hon ompih lai in, kelnou ka hon bawlsak khit matan uh," achi hi.
english: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “Please stay with us, that we may make a young goat ready for you.”

paite: TOUPA angel in Manoah kiang ah, "Hon khou lechin leng na an zaw ka ne kei ding. Haltum thil lan ding na hihleh TOUPA kiang a na lat ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi. Manoah in lah TOUPA angel ahi chih athei ngal kei hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Though you detain me, I won’t eat your bread. If you will prepare a burnt offering, you must offer it to Yahweh.” For Manoah didn’t know that he was Yahweh’s angel.

paite: Manoah in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Na min bang ahia, na thugen bang a hong tun chiang a ka hon pahtawi theihna ding un?" achi hi.
english: Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, “What is your name, that when your words happen, we may honor you?”

paite: TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Bangziak a ka min hon dong na hia, lamdang ahi chih theizen napi a?" achi hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why do you ask about my name, since it is incomprehensible?”

paite: Huchi in Manoah in kelnou khat leh nek ding thillat ala a; suangpi tung ah TOUPA kiang ah alan hi. Angel in thillamdangtak ahih a, Manoah leh azi in a-en nilouh uhi.
english: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering, and offered it on the rock to Yahweh. Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, maitam a pan meikuang van lam a akahtouh lai in, maitam a meikuang ah TOUPA angel apaitouta hi. Manoah leh azi in a-en nilouh ua, amaitang un lei asi uhi.
english: For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, Yahweh’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah and his wife watched; and they fell on their faces to the ground.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA angel Manoah leh azi kiang ah ahong kilak nawn kei hi. Huchi in Manoah in TOUPA angel ahi chih atheita hi.
english: But Yahweh’s angel didn’t appear to Manoah or to his wife any more. Then Manoah knew that he was Yahweh’s angel.

paite: Manoah in azi kiang ah, "Pathian i muh ziak in i si ngeingei ding,” achi hi.
english: Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”

paite: Himahleh azi in akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hon hihlup tum hileh halmang thillat leh nek ding thillat i latte asang kei ding. Hiai thil tengteng leng ahon ensak kei ding a, tu hun in hiai thilte leng hon hilh kei ding," achi hi.
english: But his wife said to him, “If Yahweh were pleased to kill us, he wouldn’t have received a burnt offering and a meal offering at our hand, and he wouldn’t have shown us all these things, nor would he have told us such things as these at this time.”

paite: Numei in tapa aneita a, amin Samson asa uh. Naungek ahong khanglian a, TOUPA'N avualzawl hi.
english: The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and Yahweh blessed him.

paite: Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal ah Mahaneh Dan mun ah TOUPA kha in atokthouta hi.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
